candidate.answerReason: Cutting off one summand from the longer segment, or joining the two summands by extending a shorter segment, makes the required sum or difference directly comparable. This is option C.

methods.label: Recognize cutting and extending
methods.explanation: To prove $a=b+c$, mark off a segment of length $b$ on the longer segment $a$ and prove that the remainder equals $c$ (cutting the longer segment), or extend $b$ by a segment of length $c$ (extending the shorter segment). This is the method of cutting the longer segment or extending the shorter segment.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing this auxiliary construction is Grade 8 geometry, based on elementary segment sums and differences.
